steps: Boil a big pot of salted water and cook the spaghetti until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water before draining.
Brown the ground turkey in the oil in a large pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic and cook a few minutes until the onion softens.
Pour in the pasta sauce, add a splash of pasta water, and simmer about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Bake the garlic toast following the box directions while the sauce simmers.
Toss the spaghetti through the sauce and serve with the toast and the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Turkey Spaghetti with Meat Sauce

steps: Cook the onion in the oil for a few minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned all the way through, breaking it into small crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a splash of water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or wrapped in a damp towel in the microwave.
Fill each tortilla with turkey, cheese, lettuce, tomato, and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey Tacos

steps: Melt half the butter in a big skillet and cook the potato cubes over medium heat, stirring now and then, until they are golden and almost tender, about 15 minutes. Set them aside.
In the same pan, cook the pork cubes until browned on the outside and cooked through. Set aside with the potatoes.
Add the rest of the butter and the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Sprinkle in the flour and stir for a minute, then slowly stir in the milk to make a simple sauce. Let it bubble until it thickens a little.
Put the pork and potatoes back in the pan, add the garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir everything together so the sauce coats it all. Cook 2 more minutes.
Cook the green beans following the bag directions and serve on the side.
recipes.title: Cubed Pork and Potato Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and green beans until the beans are tender and a little browned at the edges.
Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, then put the pork back in.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir everything together for a minute. Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Pork and Green Bean Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Stir in the peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Add the cooked rice, soy sauce, and garlic powder. Stir everything together and cook 2 more minutes so the flavors mix.
recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Skillet

ingredients.note: cooked and cooled, day-old works best

steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil in a big skillet or wok, then set them aside.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the onion and the frozen peas and carrots until tender.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry a few minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir so the rice colors evenly.
Fold the eggs back in, cook one more minute, and serve.
recipes.title: Egg Fried Rice

steps: Heat the soup and milk together in a pot, stirring now and then, until hot. Do not boil it hard.
Butter the outside of the bread slices and build sandwiches with 2 slices of cheese each.
Cook the sandwiches in a skillet over medium heat until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted, a few minutes per side.
Cut the sandwiches in half and serve with the soup for dipping.
recipes.title: Tomato Soup and Grilled Cheese

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big pot for a few minutes until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the tomato soup plus a can of water and stir well.
Simmer gently about 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until a little thicker. Taste and add salt if it needs it.
Serve in bowls topped with cheddar and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey Chili

ingredients.note: broken in half so it fits the dish

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the spaghetti until just tender and drain it.
Brown the ground turkey in the oil in a big pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the pasta sauce, milk, and garlic powder and let it simmer 5 minutes.
Mix the spaghetti through the sauce, then spread it in a baking dish.
Cover the top with the shredded cheddar and bake about 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
recipes.title: Cheesy Turkey Pasta Bake

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken strips in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, stir-fry the frozen vegetables until tender and any water has cooked off.
Put the chicken back in, add the soy sauce and garlic powder, and stir for a minute.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Chicken Stir Fry with Frozen Vegetables

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onion and the frozen peas and carrots until tender.
Put the pork back in, add the soy sauce and garlic powder, and stir for a minute.
Serve over the rice.
recipes.title: Pork Stir Fry with Peas and Carrots

ingredients.note: part for the meatloaf, part for the potatoes
spread on top as a glaze

steps: Heat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix the ground turkey, egg, bread crumbs, half the milk, onion, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl with your hands until just combined.
Shape the mix into a loaf in a baking dish and spread the pasta sauce over the top.
Bake about 45 minutes, until the middle is cooked through and no longer pink.
While it bakes, boil the potatoes until tender, then mash them with the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the green beans following the bag directions and serve everything together.
recipes.title: Turkey Meatloaf with Mashed Potatoes

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees. Toss the potato wedges with half the oil, half the paprika, and a pinch of salt, spread them on a baking sheet, and bake about 25 minutes, turning once, until crisp at the edges.
Mix the ground turkey with the garlic powder, the rest of the paprika, salt, and pepper, and shape it into 4 patties a little wider than the buns.
Cook the patties in the rest of the oil in a big skillet over medium heat, about 6 minutes per side, until cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Lay a slice of cheese on each patty for the last minute so it melts.
Serve the patties on the buns with lettuce and tomato, and the oven fries on the side.
recipes.title: Turkey Burgers with Oven Fries

steps: Boil the rotini in salted water until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Cook the onion in the oil in a big pan for a few minutes until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Pour in the diced tomatoes with their juice and simmer about 8 minutes, until a little thicker.
Stir the rotini through the chili, adding a splash of pasta water if it looks dry. Serve with cheddar on top.
recipes.title: Turkey Chili Rotini

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big pot for a few minutes until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and garlic powder and cook 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes with their juice, both cans of beans, and a cup of water. Stir well.
Simmer gently about 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the chili thickens a little. Taste and add salt if it needs it.
Serve in bowls topped with cheddar and a spoon of sour cream.
recipes.title: Turkey and Two-Bean Chili

steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water until very tender, about 15 minutes. Drain and mash with the butter, milk, and half the salt.
While the potatoes cook, heat the oven to 400 degrees and cook the onion in the oil in a big skillet until soft.
Add the ground turkey and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. Stir in the garlic powder, the rest of the salt, and the pepper.
Stir the peas and carrots into the turkey and cook 2 minutes, then spread the mix in a baking dish.
Spread the mashed potatoes over the top, sprinkle with cheddar, and bake about 15 minutes, until the top is golden in spots.
recipes.title: Turkey Shepherd's Pie

steps: Mix the ground turkey, egg, bread crumbs, garlic, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl with your hands until just combined. Roll into balls about the size of a golf ball.
Brown the meatballs in the oil in a big skillet, turning them so they color on all sides, about 8 minutes. They do not need to be cooked through yet.
Pour the pasta sauce over the meatballs, cover, and simmer gently about 12 minutes, until the meatballs are cooked through.
While they simmer, boil the spaghetti in salted water until just tender and drain it.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the spaghetti.
recipes.title: Turkey Meatballs with Spaghetti

steps: Toss the chicken strips with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt.
Cook the chicken in the oil in a big skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the peppers and onion until soft with browned edges, about 8 minutes.
Put the chicken back in and stir everything together for a minute.
Warm the tortillas and serve the chicken and vegetables in them with cheese and sour cream.
recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas

steps: Cook the chicken pieces in half the oil in a big skillet until cooked through. Stir in the chili powder and garlic powder, then set the chicken aside.
Cook the diced pepper in the same pan for a few minutes until it softens a little.
Lay out 4 tortillas and divide the chicken, pepper, and cheese over them. Top with the other 4 tortillas.
Cook each quesadilla in the rest of the oil over medium heat until the outside is crisp and golden and the cheese is melted, a few minutes per side.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions and keep it warm.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and cook a few minutes until soft, then add the broccoli and cook until tender.
Stir in the cooked rice, milk, garlic powder, and salt.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover the pan, and let it sit off the heat for 2 minutes until the cheese melts. Stir it through and serve.
recipes.title: Cheesy Chicken and Broccoli Rice

steps: Boil the egg noodles until just tender and drain them.
Cook the chicken pieces in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
Melt the butter in the same pan and cook the onion a few minutes until soft. Stir in the flour and cook 1 minute.
Slowly stir in the milk and let it bubble until it thickens into a simple sauce. Stir in the peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Add the noodles and chicken back in with the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir everything together and cook 2 more minutes.
recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Skillet

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big pan for a few minutes until soft.
Add the chicken breasts, the tomato soup, and a soup can of water. Cover and simmer gently about 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Take the chicken out and shred it with two forks.
Stir the chili powder and garlic powder into the sauce and simmer a few minutes until it thickens a little.
Put the chicken back in the sauce and stir it through. Spoon it onto the buns and serve the salad on the side.
recipes.title: Sloppy Chicken Sandwiches

ingredients.note: cooked and cooled, day-old works best

steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil in a big skillet or wok, then set them aside.
Add the rest of the oil and cook the pork cubes until browned and cooked through.
Add the onion and the frozen peas and carrots and cook until tender.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry a few minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir so the rice colors evenly. Fold the eggs back in, cook one more minute, and serve.
recipes.title: Pork Fried Rice

steps: Heat the oven to 425 degrees.
Toss the potato wedges with half the oil, half the garlic powder and paprika, and a pinch of salt. Spread them on a big baking sheet and roast 15 minutes.
Toss the pork cubes, onion wedges, and green beans with the rest of the oil and spices.
Add the pork and vegetables to the sheet with the potatoes and spread everything into one layer.
Roast about 15 minutes more, until the pork is cooked through and the potatoes are crisp at the edges.
recipes.title: Sheet Pan Pork and Potatoes

steps: Toss the pork strips with the chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt.
Cook the pork in the oil in a big skillet over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook the peppers and onion until soft with browned edges, about 8 minutes.
Put the pork back in and stir everything together for a minute.
Warm the tortillas and serve the pork and vegetables in them with cheese and sour cream.
recipes.title: Pork Fajitas

steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until soft.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on the outside.
Stir in the pasta sauce, chili powder, and garlic powder. Cover and simmer gently about 10 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and the sauce thickens a little.
Spoon the pork and sauce onto the buns and serve the salad on the side.
recipes.title: Saucy Pork Sandwiches

steps: Boil the rotini in salted water until just tender. Save a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Cook the pork cubes in the oil in a big skillet until browned and cooked through.
Add the peas and carrots and cook until heated through.
Stir in the rotini, milk, and garlic powder, adding a splash of pasta water to make a light sauce.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover, and let it sit off the heat 2 minutes until melted. Stir through and serve.
recipes.title: Cheesy Pork Rotini Skillet

steps: Cook the potato cubes in the oil in a big skillet over medium heat, stirring now and then, until golden and tender, about 15 minutes.
Add the onion and pepper and cook a few minutes until soft. Stir in the paprika, salt, and pepper.
Beat the eggs in a bowl and pour them evenly over the potatoes.
Cover and cook on low about 5 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover for 1 more minute to melt it, and serve straight from the pan.
recipes.title: Potato and Egg Breakfast Skillet

steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until soft.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper and pour them into the pan. Stir gently as they cook until they are scrambled and just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or in the microwave under a damp towel.
Divide the eggs over the tortillas, sprinkle with cheddar, and roll them up burrito style.
Serve with sour cream on the side.
recipes.title: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Burritos

steps: Heat the oven to 400 degrees.
Cook the onion and frozen vegetables in the oil in an oven-safe skillet until the vegetables are tender and any water has cooked off.
Beat the eggs with the milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and pour them over the vegetables.
Cook on the stove on low for about 3 minutes, until the edges start to set, then sprinkle the cheddar on top.
Move the skillet to the oven and bake about 10 minutes, until the middle is set. Let it rest 5 minutes, then slice it like a pie.
recipes.title: Veggie Frittata

steps: Cook the potato cubes in the oil in a big skillet over medium heat, stirring now and then, until golden and tender, about 15 minutes. Add the onion, paprika, salt, and pepper for the last 5 minutes. Set aside and keep warm.
Beat 2 eggs at a time in a small bowl.
Melt a little butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat, pour in the eggs, and let them set, tilting the pan so the runny egg reaches the edges.
Lay a slice of cheese on one half, fold the omelet over, and slide it onto a plate. Repeat for the other 3 omelets.
Serve the omelets with the home fries.
recipes.title: Cheese Omelets with Home Fries

steps: Boil the rotini in salted water until just tender and drain it.
In the same pot, melt the butter and stir in the flour. Cook 1 minute, stirring all the time.
Slowly stir in the milk and let it bubble gently until it thickens into a smooth sauce.
Take the pot off the heat and stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until it melts. Stir in the garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Stir the rotini back through the sauce and serve right away.
recipes.title: Stovetop Rotini Mac and Cheese

steps: Cook the diced pepper in half the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until it softens a little. Set aside.
Lay out 4 tortillas and divide the cheese and pepper over them. Top with the other 4 tortillas.
Cook each quesadilla in the rest of the oil over medium heat until the outside is crisp and golden and the cheese is melted, a few minutes per side.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and the garden salad on the side.
recipes.title: Cheese Quesadillas

steps: Heat the oven to 375 degrees. Boil the rotini until just tender and drain it.
Stir the frozen vegetables into the hot pasta and let them thaw in the heat for a minute.
Mix the pasta and vegetables with the pasta sauce, milk, and garlic powder, then spread it all in a baking dish.
Cover the top with the shredded cheddar and bake about 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling at the edges.
recipes.title: Veggie Pasta Bake

steps: Melt the butter in a big skillet and cook the potato cubes over medium heat, stirring now and then, until golden and almost tender, about 15 minutes.
Add the onion and cook a few minutes until soft.
Stir in the peas and carrots, garlic powder, salt, and pepper and cook until heated through.
Pour in the milk, sprinkle the cheddar over the top, cover, and cook on low about 3 minutes until the cheese melts into the potatoes.
recipes.title: Cheesy Potato and Pea Skillet

steps: Cook the rice following the bag directions if it is not already cooked, and keep it warm.
Cook the onion in the oil in a big skillet for a few minutes until soft.
Add the beans, chili powder, and cumin with a splash of water. Mash some of the beans with the back of a spoon and simmer about 5 minutes until thick.
Warm the tortillas, then divide the rice, beans, and cheese over them and roll them up burrito style.
Serve with sour cream on the side.
recipes.title: Bean and Cheese Burritos
